hooks.text: Jupiter doesn't actually orbit the center of the Sun.
Jupiter is not actually orbiting around the Sun's interior.
Jupiter orbits a point in empty space above the Sun.

title: Why Jupiter Doesn't Actually Orbit the Sun
description: Jupiter's massive gravity pulls the center of its orbit into empty space just above the solar surface.

beats.text: Jupiter doesn't actually orbit the center of the Sun.
beats.visual: Jupiter global view photographed by the Juno spacecraft, 2016

beats.text: Objects orbit a shared balancing point called a barycenter.
beats.visual: Diagram of two celestial bodies orbiting a shared barycenter
queries: Barycenter two body orbit diagram illustration
Center of mass orbit physics diagram

beats.text: For Earth, that point sits deep inside the solar interior.
beats.visual: Diagram showing Earth and Sun barycenter inside the solar interior

beats.text: But Jupiter is a gas giant with immense mass.
beats.visual: Montage photo of Jupiter next to Earth to scale
queries: Jupiter Earth size scale comparison diagram
Gas giant planets solar system montage photo

beats.text: Its gravity pulls the orbital center outside the Sun's surface.
beats.visual: Sun and Jupiter barycenter orbit diagram illustration
queries: Sun Jupiter barycenter orbit diagram illustration
Jupiter Sun orbit center of mass diagram

beats.text: This barycenter sits in empty space above the Sun.
beats.visual: Sun SDO atmospheric imaging photo showing solar limb and surface
queries: Sun SDO atmospheric imaging assembly photo
Solar surface corona photo NASA SDO

beats.text: As Jupiter moves, its weight makes the Sun wobble.
beats.visual: Illustration of solar wobble around the solar system barycenter
queries: Sun wobble solar system barycenter diagram

beats.text: This specific wobble is how we find planets around other stars.
beats.visual: Radial velocity diagram illustrating exoplanet detection through star Doppler wobble
queries: Radial velocity exoplanet wobble diagram illustration

beats.text: It proves Jupiter doesn't actually orbit the center of the Sun.
queries: Jupiter full disk Hubble mosaic photo
